description: This PHP class 'ThemeImage' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\CorporateBranding\Dto' encapsulates information about images used in corporate theming, including content, filename, file type, and size. It provides methods to access image data, convert to array, create from array, and check if it is empty.

classes.name: ThemeImage
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a theme image with properties such as content, filename, file type, and size, along with methods to access and manipulate these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize ThemeImage with content, filename, fileType, and fileSize.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the image content as a string, reading from resource if necessary.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the image.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the image.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the file size of the image.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether all properties (content, filename, fileType, fileSize) are null.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an associative array representation of the ThemeImage object.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a ThemeImage object from an array.
